reason: I always get three quotes from local Manchester firms I can meet, and a company in Kuwait with no UK office and nobody to show me doesn't even make the shortlist. With 30 staff and customers finding me on Google Maps, I can't gamble my site on a firm with no track record.
objection: No past clients and no one local I can sit across from, so if it goes wrong after I've paid 70% by PayPal, who do I chase? The 'you own your code' line is good, but I've got nothing to prove they'll deliver it.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real UK businesses I could ring and a live site to look at, plus paying the bulk on launch rather than upfront.
